mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge_order (id, user_id, plan_id, gold_amount, bonus_amount, price_twd, status, gateway_provider, gateway_order_id, gateway_raw_resp, paid_at, expired_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{goldAmount}, #{bonusAmount}, #{priceTwd}, #{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{gatewayProvider}, #{gatewayOrderId}, #{gatewayRawResp}, #{paidAt}, #{expiredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recharge_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recharge_order SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at < #{now}
